analysis.narrative:

📈 **Themes:** (1) AI infrastructure and robotics deployment (Optimus scaling, Claude enterprise adoption) driving selective growth narratives, (2) Institutional crypto validation (JPMorgan Ethereum integration, corporate accumulation) versus exchange security breaches creating counterparty risk, (3) Sector rotation from consumer discretionary into defense/space and traditional finance benefiting from regulatory clarity.

Near resistance: $627 (54k OI), $625 (41k OI). Near support: $590 (80k OI), $580 (108k OI).
